reviews.title: Good value for a good sounding mic!
reviews.comment: For the price, these are nice mics and a good value!  They charge easily, have longer range than the other JBL wireless mics, and a more stable connection.  The single receiver for two mics helps preserve inputs on your mixer, the tradeoff being less customized sound levels.  Sound quality is quite good.  I ended up buying another pair! Easier and faster to set up than a wired mic.  Not suitable for every situation, but when they are, they are a breeze to set up!
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.comment:
These JBL PartyBox wireless microphones are an absolute hit. Setup was incredibly easy and they connected instantly with our PartyBox speaker. The 2.4GHz connection is very stable with no lag or dropouts even when moving around the room.
The sound quality is excellent. Voices come through clear loud and crisp which makes them perfect for karaoke parties announcements or events. There is no annoying feedback and the vocals cut through the music nicely.
Battery life is another big plus. We have used them multiple times and have not even come close to running out. The 20 hours of rechargeable battery life is impressive and very convenient. The microphones feel solid and well made and not cheap or flimsy.
If you already own a JBL PartyBox these microphones are a must have accessory. They instantly turn any gathering into a fun interactive party. Highly recommend JBL quality all the way.
reviews.author: Kawaiolu&Kahunani

reviews.title: Best darn wireless microphones that I have ever used in a long time.
reviews.comment: These things are absolutely wonderful. The range on them in a 190 foot hall from front to back was perfect no interference no cross talk nothing. It is ridiculously simple to charge these things up overnight with a USB-C charger and they run easily for an eight hour convention. We ended up buying two sets of these, the reason being we needed four microphones for a panel meeting. We ended up putting the Bluetooth receiver on our powered speakers and then the microphones were on the tables. There was no issues with four of these units meaning two sets of them working at the same time no frequency cross talk no issues with clarity and super simple to turn them on and off so you can mute them. We also use the same microphones on our video cameras and they work perfectly. In truth in reality, I had never even heard of these things meaning the model the brand yes. I definitely recommend this. It’s a wonderful design.
reviews.author: The Reader

reviews.title: Karaoke Night Just Got Way Better!
reviews.comment:
I got these JBL wireless mics for a karaoke night with friends—and they completely delivered. Setup was super simple: just plug the receiver into my PartyBox speaker and turn the mics on. That’s it. No app, no Bluetooth pairing—just instant connection. Used the mics on a non JBL speaker and still work perfectly!
⸻
✅ What I liked:
• Clear voice pickup – No weird delay or distortion. Everyone sounded great (even the tone-deaf ones 😄).
• Long battery life – We sang for 4+ hours and still had plenty of charge left.
• Solid build – They feel sturdy, not like cheap plastic toys.
• Dual mic setup – Perfect for duets or group fun.
⸻
❌ What could be better:
• Would be awesome if the volume could be adjusted directly on the mic, but that’s minor.
reviews.author: j.espi
